entries.claim: An object separating from the open gripper, landing, and remaining in place while the hand continues upward supports a visual placement judgment. An opening command alone is insufficient.
entries.conditions: When grasp and release are visible, check continuous separation and stability. Visual placement does not establish overall task success. Assess each episode independently; do not reuse answers, coordinates, or counts from past seeds.

entries.claim: Official success termination may occur before the target visibly turns red or before subsequent actions mentioned in the task description. Stop immediately after explicit success termination.
entries.conditions: Applies only when this episode's filtered feedback explicitly reports success=true and terminated=true. Do not rewrite other episodes' requirements or infer hidden success rules. Assess each episode independently; do not reuse answers, coordinates, or counts from past seeds.

entries.claim: When only final success is available and intermediate activation feedback is not visible, it does not identify which button press took effect. A commanded downward target can differ from the measured TCP position.
entries.conditions: Record action requests, measured state, unconfirmed phases, and final outcomes separately. Do not treat eventual success as causal evidence for an intervention. Assess each episode independently; do not reuse answers, coordinates, or counts from past seeds.

entries.claim: A button location in a wrist-view panel was once mistaken for a front-view coordinate; opening the original images from both cameras revealed and corrected the mistake.
entries.conditions: Before grounding a point, verify the camera and original image dimensions. Use the original front image for grounding coordinates, never a wrist-view point. Assess each episode independently; do not reuse answers, coordinates, or counts from past seeds.

entries.claim: Cross-task direction convention: interpret left/right in task descriptions and corresponding subgoals relative to the initial wrist view, or the robot's initial facing direction. Left/right in this reference are opposite to those in the usual main view. Apply this convention when selecting RouteStick subgoal templates containing left/right; do not equate main-view screen directions with task-language directions.
entries.conditions: This default convention was explicitly supplied by the user and has not been empirically established for every task. Later wrist rotation does not redefine task left/right. Image point_yx coordinates still use the referenced camera image's own pixel axes. Establish world-direction mappings from the current allowed demonstration, images, and robot state; do not blindly flip a fixed world axis. If the current demonstration conflicts with the convention, record the conflict and recheck. This is user-provided guidance, not a conclusion established by the earlier four-episode test.

entries.claim: Candidate FK, downward commands, and withdrawal commands do not prove button activation. If measured descent is still progressing reasonably, one unfinished attempt does not establish a stall. Choose continued execution or bounded correction from current images, measured motion, and feedback. Truncating a contact segment with a short prefix is only a hypothesis and does not justify changing the prefix globally.
entries.conditions: For contact-based button tasks, assess continuous RGB and actual progress in the current episode. Past successes followed both continued VLA execution and bounded correction; neither proves intervention necessity, truncation causality, an optimal prefix, or a universal contact threshold. Judge each episode independently without reusing old coordinates, counts, or seed answers.

entries.claim: release prefix must not exceed the current candidate's default_prefix, even when predicted_length and supplied FK trajectory are longer. A request above default_prefix is rejected without advancing simulation; use schedule_vla for a longer authorization over fresh candidates rather than attempting to execute the prediction tail.
entries.conditions: Observed current step-budget client rejected prefix20 with default_prefix16 and predicted_length20. Read the current candidate's default execution length; this constraint is distinct from advisory experience max_trust_steps and from schedule_vla's total budget.
